standard_prerequisites.name: A complex with cohomology concentrated in [-1, 0] has vanishing Ext^1 against every module if and only if H^{-1} = 0 and H^0 is projective
A complex over a Noetherian ring with finite cohomology modules in degrees -1 and 0 is pseudo-coherent
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the pseudo-coherent version of the criterion apply.

standard_prerequisites.name: For a pseudo-coherent complex the Ext^1 criterion may be tested against finite modules only

core_obligations: The equivalence of (1) and (2) is exactly the projective-amplitude lemma specialized to complexes with cohomology in degrees -1 and 0 (proof lines 22280-22282). Under the Noetherian hypotheses the cohomology modules H^{-1}(K) and H^0(K) are finite, so K is pseudo-coherent by the Noetherian-pseudo-coherent lemma (proof lines 22283-22285). For a pseudo-coherent complex the projective-amplitude-pseudo-coherent lemma restates the criterion with test modules restricted to finite modules, giving the equivalence with (3) (proof lines 22285-22287).
proof_roadmap: Apply the projective-amplitude lemma for (1) iff (2) (proof lines 22280-22282).
Under the Noetherian hypotheses get pseudo-coherence and use the pseudo-coherent variant for (3) (proof lines 22283-22287).
